options.name: bring_your_own_license
options.description: Use a Bring Your Own (BYO) Windows license. If true, the server is provisioned in trial mode, and you must activate your own license. If false (default), the server includes a managed Windows license billed by the platform.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Client ID (Application Management)

options.name: client_secret
options.description: Client Secret (Application Management)

options.name: cloud_init_user_data
options.description: User data for the cloud-init configuration in base64 encoding. NoCloud format is supported.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of server.

options.name: force
options.description: parameter controlling advanced features availability. Currently applicable for networking. It is advised to use with caution since it might lead to unhealthy setups.

options.name: gateway_address
options.description: The address of the gateway assigned / to assign to the server. When used as part of request body, IP address has to be part of a private/public network or an IP block assigned to this server. Gateway address also has to be assigned on an already deployed resource unless the address matches the BMC gateway address in a public network/IP block or the force query parameter is true.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Name of server.

options.name: install_default_sshkeys
options.description: Whether or not to install ssh keys marked as default in addition to any ssh keys specified in this request.

options.name: install_os_to_ram
options.description: If true, OS will be installed to and booted from the server's RAM. On restart RAM OS will be lost and the server will not be reachable unless a custom bootable OS has been deployed.

options.name: ip_block
options.description: Used to specify the previously purchased IP blocks to assign to this server upon provisioning. Used alongside the USER_DEFINED configurationType. must contain at most 1 item

options.name: ip_block_configuration_type
options.description: Determines the approach for configuring IP blocks for the server being provisioned. If PURCHASE_NEW is selected, the smallest supported range, depending on the operating system, is allocated to the server. Default value is "PURCHASE_NEW"

options.name: ipxe
options.description: iPXE configuration details. Configures the server to boot using the iPXE network boot firmware with a custom boot script.

options.name: management_access_allowed_ips
options.description: Define list of IPs allowed to access the Management UI. Supported in single IP, CIDR and range format.

options.name: netris_controller
options.description: Netris Controller configuration properties.

options.name: netris_softgate
options.description: Netris Softgate configuration properties.

options.name: network_type
options.description: The type of network configuration for this server

options.name: os
options.description: The server's OS used when the server was created. See BMC API for current list - U(https://developers.phoenixnap.com/docs/bmc/1/types/Server).

options.name: private_network_configuration_type
options.description: Determines the approach for configuring IP blocks for the server being provisioned.

options.name: private_networks
options.description: The list of private networks this server is member of.

options.name: public_networks
options.description: The list of public networks this server is member of.

options.name: rdp_allowed_ips
options.description: List of IPs allowed for RDP access to Windows OS. Supported in single IP, CIDR and range format. When undefined, RDP is disabled.

options.name: server_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the server.

options.name: ssh_key
options.description: A list of SSH Keys that will be installed on the Linux server.

options.name: ssh_key_ids
options.description: A list of SSH Key IDs that will be installed on the server in addition to any ssh keys specified in request.

options.name: storage_configuration
options.description: Storage configuration.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags to set to server, if any.
